_notes: A ruling on a corporate-action coverage gap (kind coverage_gap): an open gap (ca_coverage_gap_<SYMBOL>_<since>) or a sold holding's doubt (ca_closed_doubt_<SYMBOL>_<date>).
Required: ideaId, kind 'coverage_gap', recordId (from status), decision.
decision 'no_action': there was no action in the gap's dates; the doubt clears.
decision 'row' needs actionId: one row of the stored backfill for the symbol, dated inside the gap; when that id carries more than one payload, add payload naming the one taken.
Never a ratio for this kind (the door refuses it).
